title: Zulu Warrior
transcription:
Zulu Warrior
Split Group

I come a Zimba, Zimba-Zaiah,
I come a Zimba, Zimba-Zee,
I come a Zimba, Zimba-Zaiah,
I come a Zimba, Zimba-Zee.

See him there, the Zulu Warrior,
See him there, the Zulu Chief, chief,
chief, chief.

One half of group sings verse again, while
other half chants 'Chief' to give three rhythm.
Repeat twice, having groups switch roles.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from a clear two-page scan. Some small instructional text and dialect spellings may need verification.
